subject.title: fix(agents): time out stalled Claude live turns

question: Should this PR treat Claude thinking/progress-only stdout as non-progress on the same `noOutputTimeoutMs` budget before it leaves draft?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the PR intentionally changes when existing Claude live turns are aborted; source review cannot decide that user-facing timeout tradeoff alone.

options.title: Merge after focused proof
options.body: Accept the semantic-progress policy once a focused Testbox or live Claude proof shows thinking-only stalls fail early while text, commentary, and tool construction still survive.

options.title: Accept the policy as-is
options.body: Treat the maintainer-authored tests as enough and own the earlier timeout for long reasoning-only Claude turns.

options.title: Tune before ready
options.body: Change the semantic watchdog budget or exemptions if reviewers want a longer grace period for legitimate reasoning-only turns.

recommendation.title: Merge after focused proof
recommendation.body: Accept the semantic-progress policy once a focused Testbox or live Claude proof shows thinking-only stalls fail early while text, commentary, and tool construction still survive.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the PR and have recent adjacent agent/CLI history, so they are the best current owner for the draft policy choice.
